hypotheses.prediction: Negative-only queried windows can drive global suppression. One negative window may reproduce all-off; one update or a stronger fixed prior may reduce collapse.
An appliance with no usable queries retains its original state and coefficients. Concentrated query budgets leave other devices unadapted.
Window max-pool loss can fall while future pointwise F1 falls. Sparse positive-window activity would show the weak/pointwise supervision mismatch; it alone cannot establish causality.
Activating INITIAL coefficients alone switches active appliances from corrected-power thresholds to raw-power thresholds. Its F1 difference isolates this convention change from learned updates.

notice: Diagnostic interventions do not establish the best learner or generalisation to new households.
